````````
import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { invoke } from "@tauri-apps/api/core";
import { listen, type UnlistenFn } from "@tauri-apps/api/event";
import { ConnectionPanel } from "./ConnectionPanel";
import { DesktopWindow } from "./DesktopWindow";
import { AppearanceSettings } from "./AppearanceSettings";
import { useAppearance } from "./useAppearance";
import { themeStyle } from "./themes";
import { WorkForm } from "./WorkForm";
import { useWorkSession } from "./useWorkSession";
import { CATEGORIES, formatDuration, formatTime, type StartInput } from "./types";
import { workView } from "./workView";
import { HistoryPanel } from "./HistoryPanel";
import { useHistory } from "./useHistory";
import { formatQuantity } from "./history";
import { Icon } from "./Icon";
import { UiDialog } from "./UiDialog";
import { SettlementPanel } from "./SettlementPanel";
import { MonitoringSettings } from "./MonitoringSettings";
import "./App.css";

function App() {
  const session = useWorkSession();
  const appearance = useAppearance();
  const [historyOpen, setHistoryOpen] = useState(false);
  const [layoutOpen, setLayoutOpen] = useState(false);
  const [noteOpen, setNoteOpen] = useState(false);
  const [settlementOpen, setSettlementOpen] = useState(false);
  const [monitorOpen, setMonitorOpen] = useState(false);
  const [switchRequest, setSwitchRequest] = useState<{ input: StartInput; id: number; category: string } | null>(null);
  const [navigationError, setNavigationError] = useState("");
  const [density, setDensity] = useState<"compact" | "comfortable">("compact");
  const workspace = useRef<HTMLElement>(null);
  const active = session.snapshot?.active;
  const view = workView(session);
  const record = view.record;
  const unavailable = !view.canOperate || session.busy;
  const refreshKey = `${session.dataVersion}:${session.snapshot?.pending_count ?? 0}:` + (session.snapshot?.recent_records.map((item) => `${item.id}:${item.end_time}:${item.revision}`).join(",") ?? "");
  // Reuse the existing read-only history query and its complete category aggregates.
  const categories = useHistory(session.native, refreshKey, session.recordDeleted);
  const selected = appearance.open ? "appearance" : historyOpen ? "history" : layoutOpen ? "layout" : "home";
  const pauseLabel = session.pending === "resume_task" ? "正在继续…" : session.pending === "pause_task" ? "正在暂停…"
    : active?.is_paused ? "继续工作" : "暂停";
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!session.native) return;
    let stopped = false; let unlisten: UnlistenFn | undefined;
    void listen("workmemo:open-settlement", () => { if (!stopped) setSettlementOpen(true); })
      .then(unsubscribe => { if (stopped) unsubscribe(); else unlisten = unsubscribe; })
      .catch((failure: unknown) => { if (!stopped) setNavigationError(String(failure)); });
    return () => { stopped = true; unlisten?.(); };
  }, [session.native]);

  return (
    <DesktopWindow appearanceStyle={themeStyle(appearance.current)} density={density}
      navigation={<nav className="main-nav flex items-center gap-1" aria-label="主导航">
        <button type="button" className="nav-button" aria-label="首页" title="首页" aria-pressed={selected === "home"}
          onClick={() => { workspace.current?.focus(); workspace.current?.scrollIntoView({ block: "start" }); }}><Icon name="home" /></button>
        <button type="button" className="nav-button" aria-label="历史记录" title="历史记录" aria-pressed={selected === "history"}
          onClick={() => setHistoryOpen(true)}><Icon name="history" /></button>
        <button type="button" className="nav-button" aria-label="皮肤设置" title="皮肤设置" aria-pressed={selected === "appearance"}
          disabled={appearance.loading} onClick={appearance.begin}><Icon name="palette" /></button>
        <button type="button" className="nav-button" aria-label="布局设置" title="布局设置" aria-pressed={selected === "layout"}
          onClick={() => setLayoutOpen(true)}><Icon name="layout" /></button>
      </nav>}
      categories={<div className="category-strip" tabIndex={0} role="region" aria-label="最近30天已结束记录，横向滚动"
        onWheel={(event) => { if (event.deltaX === 0) event.currentTarget.scrollLeft += event.deltaY; }}
        aria-busy={categories.loading} title={categories.error ? "分类数量暂时无法读取" : "最近30天的已结束记录数，可横向滚动"}>
        {CATEGORIES.map((category) => <span className="category-chip" key={category} data-current={active?.category === category}>
          {category}<span>{categories.result
            ? `${categories.result.categories.find((row) => row.category === category)?.totals.records ?? 0}条` : "—"}</span>
        </span>)}
      </div>}>
    <main ref={workspace} tabIndex={-1} className={`workspace${active ? " is-active" : ""}`}>
      {appearance.notice && <p className="hint appearance-feedback" role="status">{appearance.notice}</p>}
      {appearance.loadError && <div className="notice" role="alert">
        <p>外观设置读取失败，暂时使用默认外观。工作记录不受影响。</p>
        <p className="appearance-error-detail">{appearance.loadError}</p>
        <button type="button" className="text-button" disabled={appearance.loading || appearance.open}
          onClick={() => { void appearance.reload(); }}>重新读取外观</button>
      </div>}
      {!session.native && <p className="notice preview-notice" role="status">浏览器预览 · 本地计时和保存请使用桌面应用</p>}
      {session.connectionError && <div className="error-banner" role="alert">
        <strong>无法读取或保存本地数据</strong>
        <p>{session.connectionError}</p>
        <p>显示为上次读取的状态，操作暂不可用。可先尝试刷新；若已打开另一个 WorkMemo，请使用原窗口。仍无法恢复时请重新打开应用。</p>
      </div>}
      {!session.connectionError && session.commandError && <p className="error-banner" role="alert">{session.commandError}</p>}
      {!session.connectionError && !session.commandError && session.snapshot?.warning
        && <p className="notice" role="alert">{session.snapshot.warning}</p>}
      {active?.recovery_pending && <p className="notice" role="status">
        已恢复上次未结束的任务，并保持暂停。应用关闭期间不计时，请确认后继续。
      </p>}
      {navigationError && <p className="error-banner" role="alert">托盘导航通知不可用：{navigationError}</p>}
      {session.native && <div className="monitor-status">
        <span role="status">{session.snapshot?.monitoring?.message || "正在读取监测状态…"}</span>
        <button type="button" className="text-button" onClick={() => setMonitorOpen(true)}>监测设置</button>
      </div>}
      {session.snapshot?.monitoring?.idle_warning && <p className="notice" role="status">已连续 {session.snapshot.monitoring.idle_warning_seconds} 秒没有输入，{session.snapshot.monitoring.idle_end_seconds} 秒时将自动结束。恢复操作后会取消提醒。</p>}

      <section className={`timer-card${view.mode === "finished" ? " finished-card" : ""}`}
        aria-label="当前工作" aria-busy={session.loading || session.busy}>
        <div className="task-row flex items-center justify-between gap-4">
          <div className="task-copy">
            <div className="task-eyebrow flex items-center gap-1.5"><Icon name="clock" /><span>当前工作</span></div>
            <h1>{record ? record.category : view.label}</h1>
            <p className="task-summary">
              {record ? <>数量 {formatQuantity(record.quantity)}<span className="meta-dot" aria-hidden="true">·</span>
                <span className={`state-label ${view.mode === "working" ? "working" : ""}`} role="status">{view.label}</span>
                <span className="task-control-mode">{record.control_mode === "AUTO" ? "自动监测" : "手动计时"}</span></>
                : view.caption}
            </p>
            {record && view.mode === "unavailable" && <p className="hint">{view.caption}</p>}
            {active && !active.is_paused && <p className="task-mode-hint">{active.control_mode === "AUTO" ? "工作页面与操作满足条件时自动记录" : "当前由你手动计时，自动监测不会覆盖此任务"}</p>}
            {active?.is_paused && active.pause_reason === "MANUAL" && <p className="task-mode-hint">可手动继续；开启自动恢复后，返回工作页面并操作也可继续。</p>}
          </div>
          <output className={`timer${view.timer.length > 9 ? " timer-long" : ""}`} aria-label="有效工作时长" title={view.caption} aria-live="off">{view.timer}</output>
        </div>
        {record && <div className="actions flex items-center gap-3">
          {active && <button type="button" className="round-action" disabled={unavailable} aria-label={pauseLabel} title={pauseLabel}
            onClick={() => { void (active.is_paused ? session.resume(active.id) : session.pause(active.id)); }}>
            <Icon name={active.is_paused ? "play" : "pause"} /><span className="sr-only">{pauseLabel}</span>
          </button>}
          <button type="button" className="quiet-action" onClick={() => setNoteOpen(true)} aria-label="查看任务备注">
            <Icon name="note" /><span>备注</span>
          </button>
          {active && <button type="button" className="quiet-action finish-action" disabled={unavailable} aria-label="结束并保存"
            onClick={() => { void session.finish(active.id); }}><Icon name="check" /><span>{session.pending === "finish_task" ? "正在保存…" : "结束计时"}</span></button>}
        </div>}
      </section>

      {!active && (session.snapshot || !session.native) && <section className="form-card" aria-label="开始新的工作">
        <h2 className="sr-only">{view.finished ? "开始下一项" : "开始一项工作"}</h2>
        <WorkForm disabled={unavailable} starting={session.pending === "start_task"} onStart={session.start} />
      </section>}
      {active?.is_paused && <details className="switch-panel">
        <summary>开始另一项工作</summary>
        <WorkForm disabled={unavailable} switching starting={session.pending === "start_task"} onStart={async input => {
          setSwitchRequest({ input, id: active.id, category: active.category }); return false;
        }} />
      </details>}

      {session.native && session.snapshot && <div className="settlement-entry">
        <button type="button" className="secondary" onClick={() => setSettlementOpen(open => !open)}>
          待补全工作量（{session.snapshot.pending_count}）</button>
      </div>}
      <SettlementPanel open={settlementOpen} onClose={() => setSettlementOpen(false)} refreshKey={refreshKey}
        busy={unavailable} onSave={session.settle} />

      <UiDialog open={switchRequest !== null} onClose={() => { if (!session.busy) setSwitchRequest(null); }} id="switch-title" title="确认切换工作">
        {switchRequest && <div className="switch-confirm grid gap-3">
          <p>将结束并保存当前暂停的“{switchRequest.category}”，然后开始手动工作“{switchRequest.input.category}”。</p>
          <p className="hint">原任务会保留在待补全列表；此操作不会覆盖记录。</p>
          {session.commandError && <p className="error-banner" role="alert">{session.commandError}</p>}
          <div className="confirm-actions flex gap-2"><button type="button" className="secondary" disabled={session.busy} onClick={() => setSwitchRequest(null)}>取消</button>
            <button type="button" disabled={session.busy} onClick={() => { void session.start(switchRequest.input, switchRequest.id).then(saved => { if (saved) setSwitchRequest(null); }); }}>确认保存并开始</button></div>
        </div>}
      </UiDialog>
      <AppearanceSettings appearance={appearance} />
      <MonitoringSettings open={monitorOpen} onClose={() => setMonitorOpen(false)} onSaved={() => { void session.refresh(); }} />
      <UiDialog open={layoutOpen} onClose={() => setLayoutOpen(false)} id="layout-title" title="布局设置">
        <fieldset className="density-settings">
          <legend>显示间距</legend>
          <div className="density-options">
            <button type="button" className="secondary" aria-pressed={density === "compact"} onClick={() => setDensity("compact")}>紧凑</button>
            <button type="button" className="secondary" aria-pressed={density === "comfortable"} onClick={() => setDensity("comfortable")}>舒展</button>
          </div>
          <p className="hint">调整当前窗口的显示间距。</p>
        </fieldset>
        <details className="utilities-panel">
          <summary>连接与刷新</summary>
          <button className="secondary" type="button" disabled={!session.native || session.busy}
            onClick={() => { void session.refresh(); void categories.reload(); }}><Icon name="refresh" />刷新记录</button>
          <ConnectionPanel />
          <button type="button" className="secondary" disabled={!session.native || session.busy}
            onClick={() => { void invoke("exit_app").catch(failure => setNavigationError(String(failure))); }}>退出 WorkMemo</button>
        </details>
      </UiDialog>
      <UiDialog open={noteOpen && !!record} onClose={() => setNoteOpen(false)} id="note-title" title="任务详情与备注">
        {record && <>
          <p className="note-heading">{record.category} · 数量 {formatQuantity(record.quantity)}</p>
          <p className="hint">开始 {formatTime(record.start_time)}
            {record.end_time !== null && <><br />保存 {formatTime(record.end_time)}</>}</p>
          <p className="task-remark">{record.remark || "这项工作未填写备注。"}</p>
        </>}
      </UiDialog>
      <HistoryPanel open={historyOpen} onClose={() => setHistoryOpen(false)} onDeleted={session.recordDeleted} refreshKey={refreshKey}>
        <details className="recent-panel">
          <summary>最近保存的记录</summary>
          {session.snapshot?.recent_records.length ? <ul className="record-list">
            {session.snapshot.recent_records.map((record) => <li key={record.id}>
              <div className="record-heading"><strong>{record.category} · {formatQuantity(record.quantity)} · {record.settlement_status === "PENDING" ? "待补全" : "已结算"}</strong>
                <span>{formatDuration(record.duration_seconds)}</span></div>
              <p className="hint">{formatTime(record.start_time)}<br />至 {record.end_time !== null ? formatTime(record.end_time) : "—"}</p>
              {record.remark && <p className="record-remark">{record.remark}</p>}
            </li>)}
          </ul> : <p className="hint">{session.snapshot ? "还没有已结束的记录。结束计时后会保存在这台电脑上。" : "连接本地数据后可查看真实记录。"}</p>}
          <p className="hint">此处显示最近 5 条计时已结束的记录。</p>
        </details>
      </HistoryPanel>
    </main>
    </DesktopWindow>
  );
}

export default App;
````````

````````
import { Icon } from "./Icon";
import { useEffect, useRef } from "react";
import { MAX_OPACITY, MIN_OPACITY, THEME_IDS, THEMES, themeStyle } from "./themes";
import type { AppearanceController } from "./useAppearance";

export function AppearanceSettings({ appearance }: { appearance: AppearanceController }) {
  const dialog = useRef<HTMLDialogElement>(null);
  useEffect(() => {
    const element = dialog.current;
    if (!element) return;
    if (appearance.open && !element.open) element.showModal();
    if (!appearance.open && element.open) element.close();
  }, [appearance.open]);

  return (
    <dialog ref={dialog} className="appearance-dialog" aria-labelledby="appearance-title"
      onCancel={(event) => { event.preventDefault(); appearance.cancel(); }}>
      <div className="settings-heading">
        <h2 id="appearance-title">外观设置</h2>
        <button type="button" className="window-control" aria-label="取消预览并关闭外观设置"
          disabled={appearance.saving} onClick={appearance.cancel}><Icon name="close" /></button>
      </div>
      <p className="hint">即时预览，保存后下次沿用。</p>
      <fieldset disabled={appearance.saving} className="theme-fieldset">
        <legend>选择皮肤</legend>
        <div className="theme-grid grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
          {THEME_IDS.map((id) => <button type="button" key={id}
            className="theme-choice" aria-pressed={appearance.current.theme === id}
            style={themeStyle({ version: 1, theme: id, opacity: THEMES[id].defaultOpacity })}
            onClick={() => appearance.selectTheme(id)}>
            <span className="theme-sample" aria-hidden="true"><span /><span /><span /></span>
            <span className="theme-label"><strong>{THEMES[id].name}</strong>
              <span>{appearance.current.theme === id ? "✓ " : ""}{THEMES[id].description}</span></span>
          </button>)}
        </div>
      </fieldset>
      <div className="opacity-heading">
        <label htmlFor="appearance-opacity">背景不透明度</label>
        <output htmlFor="appearance-opacity">{appearance.current.opacity}%</output>
      </div>
      <input id="appearance-opacity" className="opacity-slider" type="range" min={MIN_OPACITY} max={MAX_OPACITY}
        step={1} value={appearance.current.opacity} disabled={appearance.saving}
        onChange={(event) => appearance.changeOpacity(Number(event.target.value))} />
      <div className="opacity-scale"><span>更通透</span><span>更实</span></div>
      <button type="button" className="text-button reset-opacity" disabled={appearance.saving}
        onClick={appearance.resetOpacity}>恢复 {THEMES[appearance.current.theme].name} 默认透明度</button>
      <p className="hint">只调节背景，文字和按钮保持清晰。切换皮肤时会应用该皮肤的默认值。</p>
      {!appearance.native && <p className="notice">浏览器仅预览，不能保存桌面设置。</p>}
      {appearance.loadError && <p className="notice">原外观设置读取失败，当前为临时预览。</p>}
      {appearance.saveError && <p className="error-banner" role="alert">{appearance.saveError}</p>}
      <div className="settings-actions grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
        <button type="button" className="secondary" disabled={appearance.saving} onClick={appearance.cancel}>取消</button>
        <button type="button" disabled={!appearance.native || appearance.saving}
          onClick={() => { void appearance.save(); }}>{appearance.saving ? "正在保存…" : "保存外观"}</button>
      </div>
    </dialog>
  );
}
````````

````````
import { Icon } from "./Icon";
import { useState, type CSSProperties, type MouseEvent, type ReactNode } from "react";
import { isTauri } from "@tauri-apps/api/core";
import { getCurrentWindow } from "@tauri-apps/api/window";

const DIRECTIONS = [
  "North", "NorthEast", "East", "SouthEast", "South", "SouthWest", "West", "NorthWest",
] as const;
type ResizeDirection = (typeof DIRECTIONS)[number];

/** Window controls stay outside the drag area; closing uses the save-on-close path. */
export function DesktopWindow({ children, appearanceStyle, navigation, categories, density = "compact" }: {
  children: ReactNode; appearanceStyle?: CSSProperties; navigation?: ReactNode; categories?: ReactNode;
  density?: "compact" | "comfortable";
}) {
  const native = isTauri();
  const [error, setError] = useState("");
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);

  async function control(action: "minimize" | "close") {
    if (!native || busy) return;
    setBusy(true);
    setError("");
    try {
      const window = getCurrentWindow();
      if (action === "close") await window.close(); else await window.minimize();
    } catch (cause: unknown) {
      setError(`${action === "close" ? "无法关闭窗口" : "无法最小化窗口"}：${String(cause)}`);
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  }

  async function drag(event: MouseEvent, direction?: ResizeDirection) {
    if (!native || event.button !== 0 || busy) return;
    event.preventDefault();
    setError("");
    try {
      const window = getCurrentWindow();
      if (direction) await window.startResizeDragging(direction); else await window.startDragging();
    } catch (cause: unknown) {
      setError(`${direction ? "无法调整窗口大小" : "无法移动窗口"}：${String(cause)}`);
    }
  }

  return (
    <div className="desktop-frame" data-density={density} style={appearanceStyle}>
      <div className="app-shell">
        <header className="titlebar">
          <div className="titlebar-drag" title={native ? "按住这里移动窗口" : "请在桌面应用中移动窗口"}
            onMouseDown={(event) => { void drag(event); }}>
            <img className="brand-mark" src="/workmemo.png" alt="" aria-hidden="true" draggable={false} />
            <span className="brand-name">WorkMemo</span>
          </div>
          {navigation}
          {categories}
          <div className="window-controls" aria-label="窗口操作">
            <button type="button" className="window-control" aria-label="最小化窗口"
              title={native ? "最小化" : "仅桌面应用可用"} disabled={!native || busy}
              onClick={() => { void control("minimize"); }}>
              <Icon name="minimize" />
            </button>
            <button type="button" className="window-control window-close" aria-label="关闭到后台"
              title={native ? "关闭到后台；可通过托盘退出" : "仅桌面应用可用"} disabled={!native || busy}
              onClick={() => { void control("close"); }}>
              <Icon name="close" />
            </button>
          </div>
        </header>
        {error && <div className="window-error" role="alert">{error}</div>}
        <div className="window-content">{children}</div>
      </div>
      {native && DIRECTIONS.map((direction) => (
        <div key={direction} className={`resize-handle resize-${direction}`} aria-hidden="true"
          onMouseDown={(event) => { void drag(event, direction); }} />
      ))}
    </div>
  );
}
````````

````````
import { Icon } from "./Icon";
import { useEffect, useRef, useState, type FormEvent, type ReactNode } from "react";
import { CATEGORIES, formatDuration, formatTime } from "./types";
import { formatQuantity, historyQueryError, localDate, type Totals } from "./history";
import { useHistory } from "./useHistory";

interface Props {
  open: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  refreshKey: string;
  onDeleted: (id: number) => Promise<void>;
  children?: ReactNode;
}

function StatsTable({ label, rows }: { label: string; rows: { name: string; totals: Totals }[] }) {
  return <section className="stats-section">
    <h3>{label}</h3>
    <div className="stats-scroll"><table>
      <caption className="sr-only">{label}的记录数、待补全数、已结算数量和有效工作时长</caption>
      <thead><tr><th scope="col">{label === "每日汇总" ? "工作日期" : "工作类别"}</th>
        <th scope="col">记录</th><th scope="col">待补全</th><th scope="col">数量</th><th scope="col">有效时长</th></tr></thead>
      <tbody>{rows.map(({ name, totals }) => <tr key={name}><th scope="row">{name}</th>
        <td>{totals.records}</td><td>{totals.pending_records}</td><td>{formatQuantity(totals.quantity)}</td>
        <td>{formatDuration(totals.duration_ms / 1000)}</td></tr>)}</tbody>
    </table></div>
  </section>;
}

export function HistoryPanel({ open, onClose, refreshKey, onDeleted, children }: Props) {
  const history = useHistory(open, refreshKey, onDeleted);
  const { query, result, target } = history;
  const dialog = useRef<HTMLDialogElement>(null);
  const confirmation = useRef<HTMLDialogElement>(null);
  const cancelDelete = useRef<HTMLButtonElement>(null);
  const [tab, setTab] = useState<"records" | "stats">("records");
  const [draft, setDraft] = useState(query);
  const [filterError, setFilterError] = useState("");

  useEffect(() => {
    if (open && !dialog.current?.open) dialog.current?.showModal();
    if (!open && dialog.current?.open) dialog.current?.close();
  }, [open]);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (target && !confirmation.current?.open) {
      confirmation.current?.showModal();
      cancelDelete.current?.focus();
    }
    if (!target && confirmation.current?.open) confirmation.current.close();
  }, [target]);

  function submit(event: FormEvent) {
    event.preventDefault();
    const next = { ...draft, page: 1 };
    const message = historyQueryError(next);
    setFilterError(message);
    if (!message) history.apply(next);
  }
  const pages = result ? Math.max(1, Math.ceil(result.filtered.records / result.page_size)) : 1;

  return <dialog ref={dialog} className="history-dialog" aria-labelledby="history-title"
    onCancel={(event) => { event.preventDefault(); if (!history.deleting) onClose(); }}>
    <div className="settings-heading">
      <h2 id="history-title">历史与统计</h2>
      <button type="button" className="window-control" aria-label="关闭历史与统计"
        disabled={history.deleting} onClick={onClose}><Icon name="close" /></button>
    </div>
    {children}
    <p className="hint">按本机时间的任务开始日期查询。工时包含待补全记录，数量仅汇总已结算记录。跨午夜归入开始日。</p>
    <form className="history-filters" onSubmit={submit} noValidate>
      <div className="field-row grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
        <label>开始日期<input type="date" min="1970-01-01" max="9999-12-31" value={draft.start_date}
          disabled={!history.native || history.deleting} onChange={(event) => { setFilterError(""); setDraft({ ...draft, start_date: event.target.value }); }} /></label>
        <label>结束日期<input type="date" min="1970-01-01" max="9999-12-31" value={draft.end_date}
          disabled={!history.native || history.deleting} onChange={(event) => { setFilterError(""); setDraft({ ...draft, end_date: event.target.value }); }} /></label>
      </div>
      <div className="filter-category-row">
        <label>工作类别<select value={draft.category ?? ""} disabled={!history.native || history.deleting}
          onChange={(event) => { setFilterError(""); setDraft({ ...draft, category: event.target.value || null }); }}>
          <option value="">全部类别</option>
          {CATEGORIES.map((category) => <option key={category}>{category}</option>)}
        </select></label>
        <button type="submit" disabled={!history.native || history.loading || history.deleting}>
          <Icon name="search" />{history.loading ? "正在查询…" : "查询"}</button>
      </div>
      <p className="hint">默认最近 30 天，单次最多 366 天；可更改日期查看更早记录。</p>
      {filterError && <p className="inline-error" role="alert">{filterError}</p>}
    </form>
    <div className="history-tabs grid grid-cols-2 gap-2" aria-label="查看内容">
      <button type="button" className="secondary" aria-pressed={tab === "records"} onClick={() => setTab("records")}><Icon name="list" />工作记录</button>
      <button type="button" className="secondary" aria-pressed={tab === "stats"} onClick={() => setTab("stats")}><Icon name="chart" />统计汇总</button>
    </div>
    {!history.native && <p className="notice">浏览器预览不能查询或删除本地工作记录，请打开桌面应用。</p>}
    {history.notice && <p className="history-feedback" role="status">{history.notice}</p>}
    {history.loading && <p className="hint" role="status">正在读取记录和汇总…</p>}
    {history.error && <div className="error-banner" role="alert">
      <p>{history.error}</p><button type="button" className="text-button" disabled={history.loading || history.deleting}
        onClick={() => { void history.reload(); }}>重新读取</button>
    </div>}
    {result && <div aria-busy={history.loading}>
      <p className="history-overview">全部已结束：{result.overview.records} 条 · 待补全 {result.overview.pending_records} 条 · 已结算数量 {formatQuantity(result.overview.quantity)}
        <br />累计有效时长 {formatDuration(result.overview.duration_ms / 1000)}</p>
      <p className="hint">当前范围：{query.start_date} 至 {query.end_date} · {query.category ?? "全部类别"}</p>
      <dl className="summary-grid">
        <div><dt>结束记录</dt><dd>{result.filtered.records}<small> 条（待补全 {result.filtered.pending_records}）</small></dd></div>
        <div><dt>工作数量</dt><dd>{formatQuantity(result.filtered.quantity)}</dd></div>
        <div><dt>有效时长</dt><dd>{formatDuration(result.filtered.duration_ms / 1000)}</dd></div>
      </dl>
      {result.filtered.records === 0 ? <p className="history-empty">这个范围还没有已结束记录。可以调整日期或类别；结束计时后记录会出现在这里。</p>
        : tab === "records" ? <>
          <ol className="history-records">
            {result.records.map((record) => <li key={record.id}>
              <div className="record-heading"><strong>{record.category} · {formatQuantity(record.quantity)} · {record.settlement_status === "PENDING" ? "待补全" : "已结算"}</strong>
                <span>{formatDuration(record.duration_seconds)}</span></div>
              <p className="hint">工作日期 {localDate(new Date(record.start_time))}<br />
                开始 {formatTime(record.start_time)}<br />结束 {record.end_time !== null ? formatTime(record.end_time) : "—"}</p>
              <p className="record-remark">{record.remark || "未填写备注"}</p>
              <button type="button" className="text-button delete-link" disabled={history.loading || history.deleting}
                aria-label={`删除 ${record.category} 记录 ${record.id}`} onClick={() => history.chooseDelete(record)}><Icon name="delete" />删除记录</button>
            </li>)}
          </ol>
          <nav className="history-pagination" aria-label="历史记录分页">
            <button type="button" className="secondary" disabled={history.loading || result.page <= 1}
              onClick={() => history.apply({ ...query, page: result.page - 1 })}><Icon name="left" />上一页</button>
            <span>第 {result.page} / {pages} 页</span>
            <button type="button" className="secondary" disabled={history.loading || result.page >= pages}
              onClick={() => history.apply({ ...query, page: result.page + 1 })}>下一页<Icon name="right" /></button>
          </nav>
        </> : <>
          <StatsTable label="按类别汇总" rows={result.categories.map((row) => ({ name: row.category, totals: row.totals }))} />
          <StatsTable label="每日汇总" rows={result.daily.map((row) => ({ name: row.date, totals: row.totals }))} />
          <p className="hint">汇总覆盖当前全部筛选结果，不限于当前页。数量直接相加；时长先合计毫秒再显示到秒。</p>
        </>}
    </div>}

    <dialog ref={confirmation} className="delete-dialog" aria-labelledby="delete-title" aria-describedby="delete-description"
      onCancel={(event) => { event.preventDefault(); event.stopPropagation(); history.cancelDelete(); }}>
      <h2 id="delete-title">删除这条记录？</h2>
      <p id="delete-description">将永久删除这条已完成记录，并重新计算统计。此操作不能撤销。</p>
      {target && <div className="delete-record-detail">
        <strong>{target.category} · {formatQuantity(target.quantity)}</strong>
        <p>开始 {formatTime(target.start_time)}<br />结束 {target.end_time !== null ? formatTime(target.end_time) : "—"}
          <br />有效时长 {formatDuration(target.duration_seconds)}</p>
        <p className="record-remark">{target.remark || "未填写备注"}</p>
      </div>}
      {history.deleteError && <p className="error-banner" role="alert">{history.deleteError}</p>}
      <div className="settings-actions grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
        <button ref={cancelDelete} type="button" className="secondary" disabled={history.deleting} onClick={history.cancelDelete}>取消</button>
        <button type="button" className="danger-button" disabled={history.deleting} onClick={() => { void history.remove(); }}>
          {history.deleting ? "正在删除…" : "确认删除"}</button>
      </div>
    </dialog>
  </dialog>;
}
````````

````````
import type { CSSProperties } from "react";
import {
  HomeOutlined, HistoryOutlined, BgColorsOutlined, AppstoreOutlined,
  FileTextOutlined, CheckCircleOutlined, PauseOutlined, CaretRightFilled,
  CloseOutlined, SyncOutlined, MinusOutlined, ArrowUpOutlined,
  SettingOutlined, ClockCircleOutlined, SearchOutlined, DeleteOutlined,
  BarChartOutlined, UnorderedListOutlined, LeftOutlined, RightOutlined,
} from "@ant-design/icons";

const icons = {
  home: HomeOutlined, history: HistoryOutlined, palette: BgColorsOutlined,
  layout: AppstoreOutlined, note: FileTextOutlined, check: CheckCircleOutlined,
  pause: PauseOutlined, play: CaretRightFilled, close: CloseOutlined,
  refresh: SyncOutlined, minimize: MinusOutlined, open: ArrowUpOutlined,
  settings: SettingOutlined, clock: ClockCircleOutlined, search: SearchOutlined,
  delete: DeleteOutlined, chart: BarChartOutlined, list: UnorderedListOutlined,
  left: LeftOutlined, right: RightOutlined,
} as const;

export type IconName = keyof typeof icons;
export function Icon({ name, style }: { name: IconName; style?: CSSProperties }) {
  const Component = icons[name];
  return <Component className={`icon icon-${name}`} aria-hidden="true" style={style} />;
}
````````

````````
import { useEffect, useState, type FormEvent } from "react";
import { invoke, isTauri } from "@tauri-apps/api/core";
import { CATEGORIES, type MonitorConfig } from "./types";
import { UiDialog } from "./UiDialog";

type ConnectionStatus = { state: string; message: string; identifier: string; version: string; host_name: string; manifest_path: string | null; extension_path: string | null };

export function MonitoringSettings({ open, onClose, onSaved }: { open: boolean; onClose: () => void; onSaved: () => void }) {
  const [connection, setConnection] = useState<ConnectionStatus | null>(null);
  const [repairing, setRepairing] = useState(false);
  const [config, setConfig] = useState<MonitorConfig | null>(null);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState("");
  const [notice, setNotice] = useState("");
  const [retry, setRetry] = useState(0);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!open || !isTauri()) return;
    let stale = false;
    setConnection(null);
    void invoke<ConnectionStatus>("get_connection_status").then(value => { if (!stale) setConnection(value); }).catch((failure: unknown) => { if (!stale) setError(String(failure)); });
    setConfig(null); setError(""); setNotice("");
    void invoke<MonitorConfig>("get_monitor_config").then(value => { if (!stale) setConfig(value); })
      .catch((failure: unknown) => { if (!stale) setError(String(failure)); });
    return () => { stale = true; };
  }, [open, retry]);
  async function save(event: FormEvent) {
    event.preventDefault();
    if (!config || busy) return;
    setBusy(true); setError(""); setNotice("");
    try {
      const saved = await invoke<MonitorConfig>("save_monitor_config", { input: {
        enabled: config.enabled, expected_revision: config.revision, times: config.times,
        poll_interval_seconds: config.poll_interval_seconds, auto_resume_manual: config.auto_resume_manual,
        rules: config.rules.map(({ url_prefix, category }) => ({ url_prefix, category })),
      } });
      setConfig(saved); setNotice("配置已保存。请在 Chrome 扩展中同步工作站点授权。"); onSaved();
    } catch (failure: unknown) { setError(String(failure)); }
    finally { setBusy(false); }
  }
  return <UiDialog open={open} onClose={() => { if (!busy) onClose(); }} id="monitor-settings-title" title="自动工作监测">
    {!isTauri() && <p className="notice">请在 Windows 桌面程序中配置监测。</p>}
    {error && <p className="error-banner" role="alert">{error}</p>}
    {notice && <p className="notice" role="status">{notice}</p>}
    {!config && isTauri() && <button className="secondary" type="button" onClick={() => setRetry(value => value + 1)}>读取监测配置</button>}
    {isTauri() && <section className="monitor-rule" aria-label="浏览器连接诊断">
      <p role="status">{connection?.message ?? "正在检查本机连接…"}</p>
      {connection && <details><summary>连接详情</summary><p className="hint">版本 {connection.version} · {connection.identifier}<br />主机 {connection.host_name}<br />清单 {connection.manifest_path ?? "尚未就绪"}</p></details>}
      <button type="button" className="secondary" disabled={repairing} onClick={() => {
        setRepairing(true); setError("");
        void invoke<ConnectionStatus>("repair_browser_connection").then(setConnection).catch((failure: unknown) => setError(String(failure))).finally(() => setRepairing(false));
      }}>{repairing ? "正在修复…" : "修复本机连接"}</button>
      <button type="button" className="text-button" onClick={() => { void invoke("open_browser_extension").catch((failure: unknown) => setError(String(failure))); }}>打开配套扩展文件夹</button>
      <p className="hint">Chrome 扩展需加载一次本目录。EXE、ZIP 和源码版启动时均会检查并修复当前用户的本机主机注册。</p>
    </section>}
    {config && <form className="monitor-settings grid gap-4" onSubmit={(event) => { void save(event); }}>
      <label className="monitor-toggle"><input type="checkbox" checked={config.enabled} disabled={busy}
        onChange={event => setConfig({ ...config, enabled: event.target.checked })} />启用工作页面自动识别</label>
      <p className="hint">浏览器前台工作页面匹配，并有新的输入活动时开始。仅打开页面不会开始。手动计时也受空闲保护。</p>
      <fieldset className="monitor-rule"><legend>识别与恢复</legend>
        <label>浏览器状态检查间隔（秒）<select value={config.poll_interval_seconds} disabled={busy}
          onChange={event => setConfig({ ...config, poll_interval_seconds: Number(event.target.value) })}>
          {[1, 2, 3, 4, 5].map(seconds => <option key={seconds} value={seconds}>{seconds} 秒</option>)}
        </select></label>
        <p className="hint">间隔越短，状态更新通常越快，也会增加少量后台活动。网络或系统忙碌时可能延迟。</p>
        <label className="monitor-toggle"><input type="checkbox" checked={config.auto_resume_manual} disabled={busy}
          onChange={event => setConfig({ ...config, auto_resume_manual: event.target.checked })} />返回工作页面并产生新操作后，自动恢复手动暂停的任务</label>
        <p className="hint">恢复原任务，不创建新记录；需要可信的页面连接和新的输入。关闭后需手动继续。</p>
      </fieldset>
      <fieldset className="monitor-rule"><legend>计时参数（秒）</legend>
        {([
          ["away_pause_seconds", "离开工作页面后继续计时"],
          ["hold_seconds", "暂停后保留记录"],
          ["idle_warning_seconds", "无输入后提醒"],
          ["idle_end_seconds", "无输入后结束"],
        ] as const).map(([key, label]) => <label key={key}>{label}<input type="number" min={1} max={86400} step={1} required disabled={busy}
          value={config.times[key]} onChange={event => setConfig({ ...config, times: { ...config.times, [key]: event.target.valueAsNumber } })} /></label>)}
        <p className="hint">每项 1 至 86400 秒；空闲提醒须早于空闲结束。离页宽限后暂停，再等待保留期结束记录。连接中断时不计入无法确认的时间；保留期同样适用。空闲结束可能更早发生。</p>
      </fieldset>
      {config.rules.map((rule, index) => <fieldset key={rule.id} className="monitor-rule">
        <legend>工作页面 {index + 1}</legend>
        <label>工作 URL<input type="url" required maxLength={2048} disabled={busy} value={rule.url_prefix}
          placeholder="https://工作站点/路径" onChange={event => setConfig({ ...config, rules: config.rules.map((item, i) => i === index ? { ...item, url_prefix: event.target.value } : item) })} /></label>
        <label>默认类别<select value={rule.category} disabled={busy} onChange={event => setConfig({ ...config, rules: config.rules.map((item, i) => i === index ? { ...item, category: event.target.value } : item) })}>
          {CATEGORIES.map(category => <option key={category}>{category}</option>)}</select></label>
        <button type="button" className="text-button" disabled={busy} onClick={() => setConfig({ ...config, rules: config.rules.filter((_, i) => i !== index) })}>移除这条配置</button>
      </fieldset>)}
      <button type="button" className="secondary" disabled={busy || config.rules.length >= 50} onClick={() => setConfig({ ...config, rules: [...config.rules, { id: -Date.now(), url_prefix: "", category: "评测" }] })}>添加工作 URL</button>
      <p className="hint">匹配精确站点及路径边界；查询参数和片段不参与匹配。保存监测配置会暂停当前自动记录；重新确认工作页面并产生新的输入后才会恢复。</p>
      <button type="submit" disabled={busy}>{busy ? "正在保存…" : "保存监测配置"}</button>
      <details><summary>连接与隐私说明</summary>
        <p className="hint">第一版配套 Chrome 扩展。安装扩展和本机通信主机后，在扩展面板同步已配置站点授权。只传规则标识、前台匹配状态、连接状态和页面活动信号；不传 URL、网页内容或输入文本。连接断开时暂停自动累计。</p>
        <p className="hint">离开工作页面后按设置暂停并保留记录。空闲结束时扣除最后输入后的尾段，阅读或思考可能少计，可稍后人工修正。</p>
      </details>
    </form>}
  </UiDialog>;
}
````````

````````
import { Icon } from "./Icon";
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { invoke } from "@tauri-apps/api/core";
import { getCurrentWindow } from "@tauri-apps/api/window";
import { listen } from "@tauri-apps/api/event";
import { SettlementForm } from "./SettlementPanel";
import { useAppearance } from "./useAppearance";
import { themeStyle } from "./themes";
import { formatDuration, type Snapshot, type WorkNotice, type SettleInput } from "./types";
import "./App.css";

export function NotificationApp() {
  const appearance = useAppearance();
  const [notice, setNotice] = useState<WorkNotice | null>(null);
  const [snapshot, setSnapshot] = useState<Snapshot | null>(null);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState("");
  const [readError, setReadError] = useState("");
  useEffect(() => {
    let stopped = false; let reading = false;
    async function refresh() {
      if (reading) return;
      reading = true;
      try {
        const [value, current] = await Promise.all([invoke<WorkNotice | null>("get_notice"), invoke<Snapshot>("get_snapshot")]);
        if (!stopped) { setNotice(value); setSnapshot(current); setReadError(""); }
      }
      catch (failure: unknown) { if (!stopped) { setSnapshot(null); setReadError(String(failure)); } }
      finally { reading = false; }
    }
    void refresh(); const timer = window.setInterval(() => { void refresh(); }, 1000);
    return () => { stopped = true; window.clearInterval(timer); };
  }, []);
  const key = notice ? `${notice.kind}:${notice.record.id}` : "";
  useEffect(() => { if (key) void appearance.reload(); }, [key]);
  useEffect(() => {
    let stopped = false;
    let unlisten: (() => void) | undefined;
    void listen("workmemo:appearance-changed", () => { void appearance.reload(); }).then(fn => { if (stopped) fn(); else unlisten = fn; });
    return () => { stopped = true; unlisten?.(); };
  }, [appearance.reload]);
  async function later() {
    if (!notice || busy) return;
    setBusy(true); setError("");
    try { await invoke("defer_notice", { id: notice.record.id, kind: notice.kind }); setNotice(null); }
    catch (failure: unknown) { setError(String(failure)); }
    finally { setBusy(false); }
  }
  async function save(input: SettleInput) {
    if (busy) return false;
    setBusy(true); setError("");
    try {
      await invoke<Snapshot>("settle_record", { input });
      await invoke("defer_notice", { id: input.id, kind: "ended" });
      setNotice(null); return true;
    } catch (failure: unknown) { setError(String(failure)); return false; }
    finally { setBusy(false); }
  }
  const active = snapshot?.active;
  const state = active?.recovery_pending ? "上次工作待恢复"
    : active?.pause_reason === "MANUAL" ? "手动暂停 · 已停表"
    : active?.pause_reason === "AWAY" ? "离页暂停 · 已停表"
    : active?.pause_reason === "MONITOR" ? "监测中断 · 已停表"
    : active?.is_paused ? "已暂停 · 已停表"
    : snapshot?.monitoring.idle_warning ? "空闲提醒 · 暂计"
    : snapshot?.monitoring.away_pause_remaining_seconds != null ? `离页宽限 · ${formatDuration(snapshot.monitoring.away_pause_remaining_seconds)} 后暂停`

    </div>
    <button type="button" className="island-open" onClick={() => { void invoke("show_main", { settlement: false }).catch(failure => setError(String(failure))); }} aria-label="打开 WorkMemo"><Icon name="open" /></button>
    {(error || readError) && <span className="island-error" role="alert" title={[error, readError].filter(Boolean).join("；")}>!</span>}
  </div></div>;
  return <div className="desktop-frame notice-frame" style={themeStyle(appearance.current)}><div className="app-shell">
    <header className="notice-titlebar flex items-center gap-3"><span onMouseDown={event => { if (event.button === 0) void getCurrentWindow().startDragging().catch(() => {}); }}>WorkMemo 工作提醒</span>
      <button className="secondary" type="button" disabled={!notice || busy} onClick={() => { void later(); }}>稍后</button></header>
    <main className="notice-content">

      {readError && <p className="error-banner" role="alert">读取状态失败：{readError}</p>}
      {notice?.kind === "idle" && <section aria-label="空闲提醒">
        <h1>已连续 {formatDuration(notice.idle_warning_seconds)} 没有输入活动</h1>
        <p>到达 {formatDuration(notice.idle_end_seconds)} 时将结束本次计时，最后一次输入后的尾段不计入有效工时。恢复操作后会取消此提醒。</p>
        <p>当前暂计 {formatDuration(notice.record.duration_seconds)}</p>
        <button type="button" disabled={busy} onClick={() => { void later(); }}>知道了，继续稍后处理</button>
      </section>}
      {notice?.kind === "ended" && <section aria-label="工作结束提醒">
        <h1>本次工作已结束，请填写工作量</h1>
        <p className="hint">结果已保存。稍后填写不会影响下一段工作。</p>
        <SettlementForm key={`${notice.record.id}:${notice.record.revision}`} record={notice.record} busy={busy} onSave={save} />
        <button type="button" className="secondary" disabled={busy} onClick={() => { void later(); }}>稍后填写</button>
      </section>}
      {!notice && <p role="status">提醒已处理，正在更新。</p>}
      <button type="button" className="text-button" onClick={() => { void invoke("show_main", { settlement: true }).catch(failure => setError(String(failure))); }}>打开 WorkMemo 待补全列表</button>
    </main>
  </div></div>;
}
````````

````````
import { Icon } from "./Icon";
import { useEffect, useState, type FormEvent } from "react";
import { invoke } from "@tauri-apps/api/core";
import { CATEGORIES, formatDuration, formatTime, type SettleInput, type WorkRecord } from "./types";
import { validateWorkInput } from "./workInput";

export function SettlementForm({ record, busy, onSave }: {
  record: WorkRecord; busy: boolean; onSave: (input: SettleInput) => Promise<boolean>;
}) {
  const [category, setCategory] = useState(record.category);
  const [quantity, setQuantity] = useState(record.quantity === null ? "" : String(record.quantity));
  const [remark, setRemark] = useState(record.remark);
  const [error, setError] = useState("");
  async function submit(event: FormEvent) {
    event.preventDefault();
    if (busy) return;
    const result = validateWorkInput(category, quantity, remark, true);
    if (!result.ok) { setError(Object.values(result.errors).join(" ")); return; }
    if (result.input.quantity === null) return;
    setError("");
    const saved = await onSave({ ...result.input, quantity: result.input.quantity, id: record.id, expected_revision: record.revision });
    if (!saved) setError("保存未完成，请查看上方错误信息后重试。输入内容仍保留。");
  }
  return <form className="settlement-form" onSubmit={(event) => { void submit(event); }} noValidate>
    <p className="hint">开始 {formatTime(record.start_time)}<br />
      有效结束 {record.end_time === null ? "—" : formatTime(record.end_time)}<br />
      系统确认 {record.confirmed_end_time === null ? "—" : formatTime(record.confirmed_end_time)}<br />
      有效工时 {formatDuration(record.duration_seconds)}</p>
    <div className="field-row grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
      <label>工作类别<select value={category} disabled={busy} onChange={(event) => setCategory(event.target.value)}>
        {CATEGORIES.map(value => <option key={value}>{value}</option>)}
      </select></label>
      <label>工作量（必填）<input type="number" min="0" max="1000000000" step="any" inputMode="decimal"
        value={quantity} disabled={busy} placeholder="0 表示无产出" onChange={(event) => setQuantity(event.target.value)} /></label>
    </div>
    <label>备注（选填）<textarea rows={2} value={remark} disabled={busy} maxLength={4000}
      onChange={(event) => setRemark(event.target.value)} /></label>
    {error && <p className="inline-error" role="alert">{error}</p>}
    <button type="submit" disabled={busy}><span>{busy ? "正在保存…" : "填写工作量并保存"}</span><Icon name="check" /></button>
  </form>;
}

export function SettlementPanel({ open, onClose, refreshKey, busy, onSave }: {
  open: boolean; onClose: () => void; refreshKey: string; busy: boolean;
  onSave: (input: SettleInput) => Promise<boolean>;
}) {
  const [records, setRecords] = useState<WorkRecord[] | null>(null);
  const [error, setError] = useState("");
  const [reload, setReload] = useState(0);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!open) return;
    let stale = false;
    setError("");
    void invoke<WorkRecord[]>("get_pending_records").then(data => { if (!stale) setRecords(data); })
      .catch((failure: unknown) => { if (!stale) setError(String(failure)); });
    return () => { stale = true; };
  }, [open, refreshKey, reload]);
  if (!open) return null;
  return <section className="settlement-panel" aria-labelledby="settlement-title">
    <div className="settings-heading"><h2 id="settlement-title">待补全工作量</h2>
      <button type="button" className="secondary" onClick={onClose}>稍后填写</button></div>
    <p className="hint">计时结果已保存。可以关闭这里并继续下一项工作。</p>
    {error && <div className="error-banner" role="alert">{error}
      <button type="button" className="text-button" disabled={busy} onClick={() => setReload(value => value + 1)}>重新读取</button></div>}
    {records === null && !error && <p role="status">正在读取待补全记录…</p>}
    {records?.length === 0 && <p role="status">没有待补全记录。</p>}
    {records?.map(record => <details key={`${record.id}:${record.revision}`} className="settlement-record" open={records.length === 1}>
      <summary>{record.category} · {formatTime(record.start_time)} · {formatDuration(record.duration_seconds)}</summary>
      <SettlementForm record={record} busy={busy || error !== ""} onSave={async input => {
        const saved = await onSave(input);
        if (saved) setRecords(current => current?.filter(item => item.id !== input.id) ?? null);
        return saved;
      }} />
    </details>)}
  </section>;
}
````````

````````
import { useId, useRef, useState, type FormEvent } from "react";
import { CATEGORIES, type StartInput } from "./types";
import { validateWorkInput, type InputErrors } from "./workInput";
import { Icon } from "./Icon";

interface Props {
  disabled: boolean;
  switching?: boolean;
  starting?: boolean;
  onStart: (input: StartInput) => Promise<boolean>;
}

export function WorkForm({ disabled, switching = false, starting = false, onStart }: Props) {
  const [category, setCategory] = useState("");
  const [quantity, setQuantity] = useState("");
  const [remark, setRemark] = useState("");
  const [errors, setErrors] = useState<InputErrors>({});
  const id = useId();
  const categoryRef = useRef<HTMLSelectElement>(null);
  const quantityRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
  const remarkRef = useRef<HTMLTextAreaElement>(null);
  const remarkDetails = useRef<HTMLDetailsElement>(null);

  function clearError(field: keyof StartInput) {
    setErrors((current) => ({ ...current, [field]: undefined }));
  }

  async function submit(event: FormEvent) {
    event.preventDefault();
    if (disabled) return;
    const result = validateWorkInput(category, quantity, remark);
    if (!result.ok) {
      setErrors(result.errors);
      if (result.errors.remark && remarkDetails.current) remarkDetails.current.open = true;
      (result.errors.category ? categoryRef : result.errors.quantity ? quantityRef : remarkRef).current?.focus();
      return;
    }
    setErrors({});
    await onStart(result.input);
  }

  return (
    <form className="work-form" aria-busy={starting} onSubmit={(event) => { void submit(event); }} noValidate>
      <div className="field-row grid grid-cols-2 gap-3">
        <label>工作类别
          <select ref={categoryRef} value={category} disabled={disabled}
            aria-invalid={Boolean(errors.category)} aria-describedby={errors.category ? `${id}-category` : undefined}
            onChange={(event) => { setCategory(event.target.value); clearError("category"); }}>
            <option value="">请选择类别</option>
            {CATEGORIES.map((value) => <option key={value} value={value}>{value}</option>)}
          </select>
          {errors.category && <span id={`${id}-category`} className="field-error" role="alert">{errors.category}</span>}
        </label>
        <label>工作量（可稍后填写）
          <input ref={quantityRef} type="number" inputMode="decimal" min="0" max="1000000000" step="any"
            placeholder="结束后填写；0 表示无产出" value={quantity} disabled={disabled}
            aria-invalid={Boolean(errors.quantity)} aria-describedby={errors.quantity ? `${id}-quantity` : undefined}
            onChange={(event) => { setQuantity(event.target.value); clearError("quantity"); }} />
          {errors.quantity && <span id={`${id}-quantity`} className="field-error" role="alert">{errors.quantity}</span>}
        </label>
      </div>
      <details className="form-note" ref={remarkDetails}>
      <summary><Icon name="note" />备注 <span className="optional">选填</span></summary>
      <label><span className="sr-only">工作备注</span>
        <textarea ref={remarkRef} rows={1} maxLength={4000} placeholder="记下这次工作的内容…" value={remark}
          disabled={disabled} aria-invalid={Boolean(errors.remark)}
          aria-describedby={`${id}-remark-count${errors.remark ? ` ${id}-remark` : ""}`}
          onChange={(event) => { setRemark(event.target.value); clearError("remark"); }} />
        <span id={`${id}-remark-count`} className="field-count">{Array.from(remark.trim()).length} / 2000</span>
        {errors.remark && <span id={`${id}-remark`} className="field-error" role="alert">{errors.remark}</span>}
      </label>
      </details>
      <p className="hint">先记录时间，结束后在待补全列表确认工作量。</p>
      {switching && <p className="hint">开始后将结束并保存当前已暂停的任务，工作量稍后结算。</p>}
      <button type="submit" disabled={disabled}>{starting ? (switching ? "正在保存并开始…" : "正在开始…") : switching ? "保存上一项，开始新工作" : "手动开始工作"}<Icon name="open" /></button>
    </form>
  );
}
````````

````````
export const CATEGORIES = ["评测", "质检", "开发", "文档"] as const;

export interface WorkRecord {
  id: number;
  category: string;
  quantity: number | null;
  remark: string;
  start_time: number;
  end_time: number | null;
  duration_seconds: number;
  duration_ms: number;
  status: "NOT_STARTED" | "WORKING" | "FINISHED";
  is_paused: boolean;
  recovery_pending: boolean;
  settlement_status: "IN_PROGRESS" | "PENDING" | "COMPLETE";
  source: "AUTO" | "MANUAL_START" | "MANUAL_ENTRY";
  pause_reason: "MANUAL" | "APP_CLOSE" | "RECOVERY" | "AWAY" | "MONITOR" | null;
  confirmed_end_time: number | null;
  last_input_time: number | null;
  end_reason: string | null;
  legacy_duration_ms: number;
  revision: number;
  control_mode: "AUTO" | "MANUAL";
}

export interface Snapshot {
  active: WorkRecord | null;
  recent_records: WorkRecord[];
  warning: string | null;
  pending_count: number;
  monitoring: MonitorStatus;
}

export interface StartInput {
  category: string;
  quantity: number | null;
  remark: string;
}

export interface MonitorStatus {
  enabled: boolean;
  browser_connected: boolean;
  native_available: boolean;
  work_page: boolean;
  idle_warning: boolean;
  message: string;
  revision: number;
  idle_warning_seconds: number;
  idle_end_seconds: number;
  away_pause_remaining_seconds: number | null;
}
export interface WorkUrl { id: number; url_prefix: string; category: string }
export interface TrackingTimes { idle_warning_seconds: number; idle_end_seconds: number; away_pause_seconds: number; hold_seconds: number }
export interface MonitorConfig { enabled: boolean; revision: number; rules: WorkUrl[]; times: TrackingTimes; poll_interval_seconds: number; auto_resume_manual: boolean }
export interface WorkNotice { kind: "idle" | "ended"; record: WorkRecord; idle_warning_seconds: number; idle_end_seconds: number }

export interface SettleInput {
  id: number;
  expected_revision: number;
  category: string;
  quantity: number;
  remark: string;
}

export function formatDuration(seconds: number): string {
  const total = Math.max(0, Math.floor(seconds));
  return [Math.floor(total / 3600), Math.floor((total % 3600) / 60), total % 60]
    .map((part) => String(part).padStart(2, "0")).join(":");
}

export function formatTime(milliseconds: number): string {
  return new Date(milliseconds).toLocaleString("zh-CN", { hour12: false });
}
````````

````````
import { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { invoke, isTauri } from "@tauri-apps/api/core";
import { listen, type UnlistenFn } from "@tauri-apps/api/event";
import type { Snapshot, StartInput, SettleInput } from "./types";
import { confirmedFinish, reconcileDeleted } from "./workView";

type WorkCommand = "start_task" | "pause_task" | "resume_task" | "finish_task" | "settle_record";

export function useWorkSession() {
  const native = isTauri();
  const [snapshot, setSnapshot] = useState<Snapshot | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(native);
  const [pending, setPending] = useState<WorkCommand | null>(null);
  const [savedId, setSavedId] = useState<number | null>(null);
  const [dataVersion, setDataVersion] = useState(0);
  const [connectionError, setConnectionError] = useState("");
  const [commandError, setCommandError] = useState("");
  const mounted = useRef(false);
  const busyRef = useRef(false);
  const polling = useRef(false);
  const revision = useRef(0);
  const deletedIds = useRef(new Set<number>());

  const refresh = useCallback(async () => {
    if (!native || busyRef.current || polling.current) return;
    polling.current = true;
    const request = ++revision.current;
    try {
      const data = await invoke<Snapshot>("get_snapshot");
      if (mounted.current && request === revision.current) {
        setSnapshot(reconcileDeleted(data, deletedIds.current));
        setConnectionError("");
      }
    } catch (error: unknown) {
      if (mounted.current && request === revision.current) setConnectionError(String(error));
    } finally {
      polling.current = false;
      if (mounted.current && request === revision.current) setLoading(false);
    }
  }, [native]);

  useEffect(() => {
    mounted.current = true;
    if (!native) return () => { mounted.current = false; };
    void refresh();
    const interval = window.setInterval(() => { void refresh(); }, 1000);
    const onFocus = () => { void refresh(); };
    const onVisibility = () => { if (!document.hidden) void refresh(); };
    window.addEventListener("focus", onFocus);
    document.addEventListener("visibilitychange", onVisibility);
    let stopped = false;
    const unlisteners: UnlistenFn[] = [];
    void listen<string>("workmemo:storage-error", ({ payload }) => {
      if (!stopped) setCommandError(`操作未完成：${payload}`);
    }).then((unsubscribe) => {
      if (stopped) unsubscribe(); else unlisteners.push(unsubscribe);
    }).catch((error: unknown) => {
      if (!stopped) setCommandError(`无法接收保存错误通知：${String(error)}`);
    });
    void listen<string>("workmemo:runtime-error", ({ payload }) => {
      if (!stopped) setCommandError(payload);
    }).then(unsubscribe => { if (stopped) unsubscribe(); else unlisteners.push(unsubscribe); })
      .catch((error: unknown) => { if (!stopped) setCommandError(`无法接收计时服务通知：${String(error)}`); });
    void listen<string>("workmemo:runtime-recovered", ({ payload }) => {
      if (!stopped) setCommandError(current => current === payload ? "" : current);
    }).then(unsubscribe => { if (stopped) unsubscribe(); else unlisteners.push(unsubscribe); })
      .catch((error: unknown) => { if (!stopped) setCommandError(`无法接收恢复通知：${String(error)}`); });
    return () => {
      stopped = true;
      mounted.current = false;
      revision.current += 1;
      window.clearInterval(interval);
      window.removeEventListener("focus", onFocus);
      document.removeEventListener("visibilitychange", onVisibility);
      unlisteners.forEach(unsubscribe => unsubscribe());
    };
  }, [native, refresh]);

  const run = useCallback(async (command: WorkCommand, args: Record<string, unknown>) => {
    if (!native || busyRef.current) return false;
    busyRef.current = true;
    setPending(command);
    setCommandError("");
    const request = ++revision.current;
    try {
      const data = await invoke<Snapshot>(command, args);
      if (mounted.current && request === revision.current) {
        const current = reconcileDeleted(data, deletedIds.current);
        setSnapshot(current);
        setConnectionError("");
        if (command === "start_task") setSavedId(null);
        if (command === "start_task" || command === "finish_task" || command === "settle_record") setDataVersion(value => value + 1);
        if (command === "finish_task") {
          const id = typeof args.id === "number" ? args.id : null;
          setSavedId(confirmedFinish(current, id)?.id ?? null);
        }
      }
      return true;
    } catch (error: unknown) {
      if (mounted.current) setCommandError(String(error));
      return false;
    } finally {
      busyRef.current = false;
      if (mounted.current) { setPending(null); setLoading(false); }
    }
  }, [native]);

  const recordDeleted = useCallback(async (id: number) => {
    deletedIds.current.add(id);
    setDataVersion(value => value + 1);
    setSavedId((current) => current === id ? null : current);
    setSnapshot((current) => current ? reconcileDeleted(current, deletedIds.current) : current);
    await refresh();
  }, [refresh]);

  return {
    native, snapshot, loading, busy: pending !== null, pending, savedId, dataVersion,
    connectionError, commandError, refresh, recordDeleted,
    start: (input: StartInput, expectedActiveId: number | null = null) => run("start_task", { input, expectedActiveId }),
    pause: (id: number) => run("pause_task", { id }),
    resume: (id: number) => run("resume_task", { id }),
    finish: (id: number) => run("finish_task", { id }),
    settle: (input: SettleInput) => run("settle_record", { input }),
  };
}
````````

````````
import { formatDuration, type Snapshot, type WorkRecord } from "./types.ts";

interface ViewInput {
  native: boolean;
  loading: boolean;
  snapshot: Snapshot | null;
  connectionError: string;
  savedId: number | null;
}

export function confirmedFinish(snapshot: Snapshot | null, id: number | null): WorkRecord | null {
  if (id === null || !snapshot || snapshot.active) return null;
  return snapshot.recent_records.find((record) => record.id === id
    && record.status === "FINISHED" && record.end_time !== null) ?? null;
}

// A read started before a confirmed deletion may arrive after it. Never revive that record.
export function reconcileDeleted(snapshot: Snapshot, deleted: ReadonlySet<number>): Snapshot {
  return { ...snapshot, recent_records: snapshot.recent_records.filter((record) => !deleted.has(record.id)) };
}

export function workView({ native, loading, snapshot, connectionError, savedId }: ViewInput) {
  const finished = confirmedFinish(snapshot, savedId);
  const record = snapshot?.active ?? finished;
  const mode = !native ? "preview" : loading ? "loading"
    : connectionError || !snapshot ? "unavailable"
    : snapshot.active ? (snapshot.active.is_paused ? "paused" : "working")
    : finished ? "finished" : "ready";
  const labels = { preview: "桌面预览", loading: "正在读取", unavailable: "暂不可用",
    paused: record?.recovery_pending ? "上次任务待恢复" : record?.pause_reason === "AWAY" ? "离页自动暂停" : record?.pause_reason === "MONITOR" ? "监测中断暂停" : record?.pause_reason === "MANUAL" ? "手动暂停" : "已暂停",
    working: record?.control_mode === "AUTO" ? "自动记录中" : "手动计时中", finished: finished?.settlement_status === "PENDING" ? "计时已保存，待补全" : "已完成并保存", ready: "准备开始" };
  const captions = { preview: "请在桌面应用中开始工作", loading: "正在读取本地工作记录",
    unavailable: record ? "上次读取的时长，暂未更新" : "连接本地数据后显示时长",
    paused: "暂停期间不计时", working: "暂计工时；空闲结束会扣除最后输入后的尾段",
    finished: "本次有效工作时长", ready: "选择类别即可开始，工作量稍后填写" };
  return {
    mode, record, finished, label: labels[mode], caption: captions[mode],
    timer: record ? formatDuration(record.duration_seconds) : mode === "ready" ? "00:00:00" : "--:--:--",
    canOperate: mode === "ready" || mode === "working" || mode === "paused" || mode === "finished",
  };
}
````````

````````
test('扩展固定公开标识、最小权限和原生主机来源一致', () => {
  const manifest = JSON.parse(readFileSync(new URL('../browser-extension/manifest.json', import.meta.url), 'utf8'));
  const id = [...createHash('sha256').update(Buffer.from(manifest.key, 'base64')).digest().subarray(0,16)]
    .map(n => String.fromCharCode(97 + (n >> 4), 97 + (n & 15))).join('');
  const protocol = readFileSync(new URL('../src-tauri/src/browser_protocol.rs', import.meta.url), 'utf8');
  assert.ok(protocol.includes(`chrome-extension://${id}/`));
  assert.deepEqual(manifest.permissions, ['nativeMessaging', 'alarms', 'scripting']);
  assert.equal(manifest.host_permissions, undefined);
  assert.equal(manifest.content_scripts, undefined);
});
````````

````````
};

async function backgroundScenario(run) {

  const previousInterval = globalThis.setInterval;
  const previousClearInterval = globalThis.clearInterval;
  const previousNow = Date.now;
  let now = previousNow();
  Date.now = () => now;
  const messages = [];
  let tick;
  let nextTimer = 0;
  const timers = new Map();
  let connections = 0;
  const ports = [];
  const names = [];
  const makePort = () => ({ onMessage: event(), onDisconnect: event(), postMessage: frame => messages.push(frame), disconnect() {} });
  const chrome = {
    runtime: {
      id: 'oljcealhccdhaddceacnokihjefloaih',
      getURL: path => `chrome-extension://oljcealhccdhaddceacnokihjefloaih/${path}`,
      connectNative: name => { connections++; names.push(name); const native = makePort(); ports.push(native); return native; },
      onStartup: event(), onInstalled: event(), onMessage: event(),
    },
    permissions: { contains: async () => false, onAdded: event(), onRemoved: event() },
    tabs: { onActivated: event(), onUpdated: event(), onRemoved: event(), query: async () => [] },
    windows: { onFocusChanged: event(), getLastFocused: async () => ({ focused: false }) },
    alarms: { onAlarm: event(), create: async () => {} },
  };
  globalThis.chrome = chrome;
  globalThis.setInterval = (callback, delay) => { const id = ++nextTimer; timers.set(id, { callback, delay }); tick = callback; return id; };
  globalThis.clearInterval = id => { timers.delete(id); };
  try {

    await flush();
    const status = () => {

      return value;
    };
    await run({ get native() { return ports.at(-1); }, ports, names, chrome, messages, status, timers, connections: () => connections, tick: async (advance = 5000) => { now += advance; tick(); await flush(); } });
  } finally {
    Date.now = previousNow;
    globalThis.chrome = previousChrome;
    globalThis.setInterval = previousInterval;
    globalThis.clearInterval = previousClearInterval;
  }
}
````````

````````
test('页面脚本仅对可信可见焦点事件发送布尔活动信号，并去重节流', () => {

  assert.equal(events.size,3);
  events.get('keydown')({isTrusted:false}); assert.equal(messages.length,0);
  events.get('keydown')({isTrusted:true,get key(){throw new Error('must not read key');}});
  events.get('pointerdown')({isTrusted:true}); assert.equal(messages.length,1);
  now+=250; events.get('wheel')({isTrusted:true});
  assert.equal(JSON.stringify(messages),JSON.stringify([{type:'page-activity'},{type:'page-activity'}]));
});
````````

````````
# alpha.6 自动恢复、检测与界面更新

日期：2026-10-28（Asia/Shanghai）。按用户确认方案实施，并根据后续许可增加授权工作页面活动信号。版本 0.2.0-alpha.6，Windows x64。本轮提供本地 EXE 与 ZIP，没有创建公开 Release；README 中已公开的 alpha.5 资产保持原样。

## 业务行为

- 正在进行的手动任务不会被自动监测替换；自动任务点击继续后仍按自动规则管理。手动暂停默认可在可信工作页的新操作后恢复同一记录并转自动管理，设置可关闭。重启待恢复记录必须用户明确处理。
- 切换暂停任务增加明确确认，并在后端校验被确认的记录 ID；旧确认不能误结束新的任务。结束旧记录和创建新记录保持事务执行。
- 检测间隔 1–5 秒，默认 1 秒，同时用于 Chrome 心跳与系统输入采样。已有离页与空闲秒数独立。SQLite schema 5 迁移保留旧记录和原阈值，新增默认自动恢复开关。升级前正常退出并备份，旧版可能不能打开升级后的数据库。
- 页面事件在通信忙时合并并重新读取最新状态；过期查询不发送。新增 scripting 权限，仅在配置且已授权的站点注入活动监听。脚本只发可信操作信号，不读取按键值、文本、坐标或网页内容；后台标签、未授权站点及脚本合成事件不作为活动信号。后端还核对原生输入、前台状态及暂停边界，从确认时刻计时，不回填未知区间。首次安装、未授权或监听尚未就绪时仍可能需要再次操作；没有严格实时保证。顶层页面活动监听不覆盖跨站 iframe。

## 界面与依赖

主窗口、任务卡、历史统计、删除确认、工作量结算、外观/监测设置、状态岛及 Chrome 弹窗统一整理，使用 Ant Design Icons 与 Tailwind Vite。Tailwind v4 样式要求现代 Chromium（111+）WebView2；未在旧运行环境验证。保持四套主题变量与原生透明配置；未导入 Tailwind Preflight。扩展弹窗图标和样式在本地打包，配套文件清单新增 activity.js；源码 extension 需先构建，不直接加载原始 popup.js。依赖许可汇编含 Ant 图标、Tailwind 产出样式及其依赖，缺失的包内许可按版本从上游或包内 README 补齐。

## 实际检查与限制

- npm test：37 项通过；cargo test --locked --offline：86 项库测试、2 项 helper 协议测试、2 项实际主机集成及 1 项注册测试通过，共 91 项。覆盖迁移、1/5 秒、自动恢复、重启保护、切换旧确认、首次输入边界、页面活动与授权范围、事件竞争和原有数据可靠性。
- TypeScript/Vite 构建、Rust 格式检查、bridge:dev 资源准备与扩展弹窗构建通过。桌面产物 JS 约 316.40 kB（gzip 97.03 kB），CSS 31.78 kB（gzip 6.73 kB）。
- 以独立应用标识 com.workmemo.test.qacd3bafcc2cc0 构建过隔离 GUI，并通过只读原生 probe。桌面工具请求启动该路径时实际启动了 C:\Users\Administrator\AppData\Local\WorkMemo\workmemo.exe，进程父级证实来自桌面工具；发现后停止对该窗口操作，没有结束、删除或改写真实任务。启动本身可能读取真实数据库并执行原有连接检查，无法声称真实状态全程未变化。
- 浏览器预览实际打开并检查了新版主界面布局、图标和文本，随后关闭临时页及开发服务；未将浏览器预览计为原生验收。
- 新版实际安装、Chrome 授权后的端到端联调、锁屏休眠、多屏/DPI、四皮肤原生透明、键盘焦点及提醒交互仍未验收。自动测试与构建不代替这些实测；本轮不报告为全面验收通过。
````````
